# R3B player's chair text

## chronicle

```
Thyme Greenhill became a master cheesemaker today, at the dairy. The sign over the door is new, and so is the way the neighbors say hello.
A master shopkeeper for Qoti: Angelica Wrenfield, of the shop. Years of habit, it turns out, add up to something you can paint on a board.
Tarragon Tansley is now a master shopkeeper. A sign went up over the shop, and it has been polished twice by people who were only passing.
The valley counts a new master gardener: Mother Thornbury, at the market garden. The apprentices have been told to look busy.
Teak Featherstone became a master forester today, at the forester's lodge. The sign over the door is new, and so is the way the neighbors say hello.
A master quarryman for Qoti: Barnaby Ashcombe, of the quarry. Years of habit, it turns out, add up to something you can paint on a board.
Odette Fenwick is now a master shopkeeper. A sign went up over the shop, and it has been polished twice by people who were only passing.
The valley counts a new master carpenter: Pippa Quill, at the carpenter's workshop. The apprentices have been told to look busy.
PlaquesThe plaque-maker was sent for. Master of the House: The first master took up the trade, and the apprentices began to stand a little straighter. Hung with pride by Player 1.
```
